responsibility: Defines IBM S/390 and zSeries common target policy for GCC, including the exported processor-flags table that maps named z-architecture generations to capability bitmasks, optimization defaults for scheduling/unrolling/code size, option-structure initialization for unwind tables and section anchors, validation of stack-guard and stack-size options, and support checks for split stacks. It is the architecture-wide shared configuration file that feeds option state and processor capability baselines into the main s390 backend.
